review.imagery: Thirty-two own-project renders were selected after visual review of all 27 current primary gallery/banner assets, the complete brochure index and seventeen extracted native resources. Two exact-byte primary duplicates are excluded. Seven additional visible brochure scenes supply the writer’s room, study/library doorway, gym detail, reading nooks, desk and bathroom. Background textures, book-frame masks and reused desk duplicates are excluded. The complete street building supplies the card and hero. Proposed views and final furnishings remain unit-unspecific.
review.floorPlans: Twenty-six complete home sheets show four studios, fourteen 1 BR, six 2 BR and two 3 BR variants. Fifteen complete overview sheets show the ground floor, floors 1–13 and roof. A/B versions retain their different balcony configurations and the source’s location-dependent balcony notices. Printed room dimensions remain visible, while whole-home area totals are absent. Confirm the selected unit, contractual area and final configuration with Imtiaz. All 41 complete drawing sheets on physical pages 2–42 were visually reviewed, including every A/B variant. The separate seventeen-page building-only pack was also fully screened and all fifteen drawing pages visually compared. It repeats the same floor content with raster/compression differences. The combined pack supplies one selectable copy of each building sheet. Original room dimensions, variant labels, orientation, elevation/key plans, furniture, balcony notes and source notices remain intact. Starting category sizes are not assigned to individual drawings.
review.location: The complete branded page 13 map and all eleven destination entries were visually reviewed. The current primary publishes an explicit DMS coordinate marker. That marker is decoded and converted to 25.098250, 55.375444 with a project-vicinity qualifier. Its different camera-centre parameters are excluded. DLRC community identification agrees with the protected location record and project-specific Property Finder source. Airport and ambiguous mall wording retain source scope.
review.provenance: Current official HTML/gallery assets and complete branded brochure/floor-plan PDFs have receipts and SHA256 checks. Both PDFs are hosted by Mitchell’s and remain labeled broker mirrors. Complete sheets, original source bytes and physical page links are preserved. The overlapping building-only pack remains recorded in source evidence. Protected identity and completed text research remain intact.
